# ProjectAssetSource

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Core.Editors.SceneBuilding` · assembly `VRFramework.Core.Editors` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Editor/SceneBuilder/AssetSources/ProjectAssetSource.cs#L16)

Indexes the art assets that already live in the project. Deliberately narrow: models, sounds
and textures are what a scene is built out of. Materials, shaders, animation clips and the
rest are authoring inputs rather than things you drop into a scene, so they stay in the
Project window where they belong.
This is the source that works with no configuration, and it doubles as the reference
implementation for a real external database.
